bio: The brainchild of a Franco-Korean couple of chefs who met in New York, the ubiquitous chicken is the star of this vintage bistro oozing with charm. The chef, former right-arm man of Daniel Boulud, consummately signs a gourmet gateau of sautéed chicken livers and a chicken in “half-mourning” that has already become a signature dish. This virtuoso technician has also invented a wafer-thin tart of Nashi pear, scallops and Brussels sprouts. Local game in season. Knockout wine list....
